Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism action_type 'INHIBITOR'. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_mechanism on molregno and target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
